records.claim_text: Hays separates its salary intelligence, assembled from listings, offers and candidate registrations, from its employer/employee survey. Input type, relevant role/region and data period therefore need recording before a salary benchmark is used in a case.
records.population: Selected public recruiter declarations/advice; no original JGA participants
records.limitations: No workforce survey denominator transferred to salary observations, no whole-market or pay-cost conclusion; method disclosed by interested publisher.
records.review_mode: Relevant original body/retained raw sections inspected; selected reader notes for403 routes distinguished from originals

records.claim_text: Robert Half’s live2027 UK guide describes projected starting salaries using placement compensation, third-party posting data and recruiter input. The starting-salary FAQ excludes bonuses and annual merit increases; the non-salary survey is separately described. This does not supply an employer’s full staffing or incremental cost.
records.population: Selected public recruiter declarations/advice; no original JGA participants
records.limitations: The live edition differs from indexed2026 content; retain actual edition/date. No salary amount, role forecast, statutory on-cost rate, survey percentage or trend adopted.
records.review_mode: Relevant original body/retained raw sections inspected; selected reader notes for403 routes distinguished from originals

records.claim_text: Frazer Jones’s2017 payroll advice places implementation readiness within a wider new-market/acquisition timetable and recommends early cross-functional planning and checking incumbent provider coverage/direct or subcontracted delivery. The proposal boundary may therefore be a payroll component within a wider business decision.
records.population: Selected public recruiter declarations/advice; no original JGA participants
records.limitations: Not observed decision prevalence, a universal priority of commercial teams or proof payroll concerns cannot change timing. Country-specific duties not reused as current legal guidance.

records.claim_text: The inspected market declarations cover defined SOW delivery, blended consulting/staffing and payroll recruitment. R05 should identify the actual commitment unit, deliverable/acceptance basis and retained work rather than compare a salary, day rate and managed output as equivalent offers. A talent response remains one option, not the predetermined report conclusion.
